correctness.rationale: For connected vertex- and edge-transitive d-regular H on n≥3, conjugation averaging under its automorphisms preserves feasibility and cannot increase ||P−J||₂. The orbit-symmetric family has apex-base a≤1/n, base-edge b≤(1−2a)/d, and full eigenvalues 1,1−na,1−(n+2)a,1−2a−bλ for nonzero Laplacian λ. Base minimax clips q=b/(1−2a) to min(2/(u+v),1/d). Its residual κ gives three-affine minimax max{1−na,(n+2)a−1,κ(1−2a)}, producing three stated phases and boundaries. Cyclic C_n check yields n=3 μ=.25, n=4 μ=.20, n=5 μ≈.283246387, n=6 μ=.4; general n≥6 follows sin t≤t. Independent numerical eigenspectral cycles n=3..10 corroborate but do not establish all graph cases. Clipping holds for triangular J(7,2) at q=.1 versus unconstrained 2/19.
